sloka: गम्यतामिति चोवाच आगच्छ त्वं स्मरे यदा ।सिद्धानां च गतौ सौम्य मा विषादेन योजय ।प्रतिघातश्च ते मा भूद्यथेष्टं गच्छतो दिशः ।। ७.४१.१४ ॥
transliteration: gamyatāmiti covāca āgaccha tvaṁ smare yadā ।siddhānāṁ ca gatau saumya mā viṣādena yojaya ।pratighātaśca te mā bhūdyatheṣṭaṁ gacchato diśaḥ ।। 7.41.14 ॥

translations.english: Rama then told the Pushpaka, "Depart now, and remember to return whenever I recall you; O gentle one, do not be afflicted with sorrow, and may there be no obstruction to your desired flight in any direction, like that of the Siddhas."
